items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So I used my older brother, Remus Manchin, because he was a good street drummer, first-class street drummer. So I told him, I said, come on, bud. I used to call him buddy, come on, bud, make this money. I'm going to play trombone today. My first job out.

ctx.x: Beverly Garden. That's Beverly Garden. So we had mean old man, Kimball and all of us. Papa Celestine, he went with Rizzley too. And we left Hampton Benson, I originally being a trauma player at South. And T.O., he quit P-Rone, he went on over there with us too. So we stuck out there and- You played drums then? He stuck out there a long time, making good money. So well, the boys got to say they want to go back to the red light. Went on back to the red light and played at King Holler. King Holler was at Pete…
